sql.query: SELECT mergeData.templateId,mergeData.versionNumber,mergeData.workflowId,mergeData.templateName,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(mergeData.bodyHtml,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.workflowName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.reference',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.referenceCode),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.showDate',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.showDate),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.showTime',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.showTime),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'location.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.locationName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'space.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.spaceName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'configuration.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.configurationName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'tenant.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.tenantName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'owner.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.ownerName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contact.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.contactName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contact.email',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.contactEmail) renderedHtml FROM (SELECT ct.id templateId,ct.versionNumber,w.id workflowId,ct.templateName,ct.bodyHtml,COALESCE(w.workflowName,'') workflowName,COALESCE(w.referenceCode,'') referenceCode,COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT((SELECT COALESCE(fv.valueDate,w.targetDate) FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.fieldKey='show_date' LIMIT 1),'%d %M %Y'),DATE_FORMAT(w.targetDate,'%d %M %Y'),'') showDate,COALESCE((SELECT NULLIF(fv.valueText,'') FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.fieldKey='show_time' LIMIT 1),'') showTime,COALESCE(l.locationName,'') locationName,COALESCE(s.spaceName,'') spaceName,COALESCE(c.configurationName,'') configurationName,COALESCE(t.tenantName,'') tenantName,COALESCE(u.displayName,team.teamName,'') ownerName,COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',contact.firstName,contact.lastName)),''),contact.displayName,contact.organisationName,'') FROM tbl_workflow_contacts wc INNER JOIN tbl_contacts contact ON contact.id=wc.contactId AND contact.tenantId=wc.tenantId WHERE wc.workflowId=w.id AND wc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY wc.isPrimary DESC,wc.id LIMIT 1),'') contactName,COALESCE((SELECT contact.email FROM tbl_workflow_contacts wc INNER JOIN tbl_contacts contact ON contact.id=wc.contactId AND contact.tenantId=wc.tenantId WHERE wc.workflowId=w.id AND wc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY wc.isPrimary DESC,wc.id LIMIT 1),'') contactEmail FROM tbl_contract_templates ct INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=ct.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_locations l ON l.id=w.locationId AND l.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_spaces s ON s.id=w.spaceId AND s.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_space_configurations c ON c.id=w.configurationId AND c.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=w.ownerUserId LEFT JOIN tbl_teams team ON team.id=w.ownerTeamId AND team.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE ct.id=:templateId AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND ct.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.create' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1) mergeData

sql.query: SELECT ce.id contractingEntityId,JSON_OBJECT('legalName',ce.legalName,'tradingName',ce.tradingName,'registrationNumber',ce.registrationNumber,'vatNumber',ce.vatNumber,'registeredAddress',CONCAT_WS(', ',ce.addressLine1,ce.addressLine2,ce.townCity,ce.countyRegion,ce.postcode,ce.country),'telephone',ce.telephone,'email',ce.email,'website',ce.website,'signatoryName',ce.signatoryName,'signatoryTitle',ce.signatoryTitle,'paymentTerms',ce.defaultPaymentTerms,'footer',ce.contractFooter) entitySnapshot FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_contracting_entities ce ON ce.id=COALESCE(w.contractingEntityId,(SELECT d.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities d WHERE d.tenantId=w.tenantId AND d.isDefault=1 AND d.isActive=1 LIMIT 1)) AND ce.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO tbl_contract_document_clauses (tenantId,contractId,sourceClauseId,clauseHeading,clauseTextSnapshot,clauseBehaviour,conditionKey,displayOrder,isIncluded,isCustom,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT tc.tenantId,:contractId,tc.clauseId,tc.clauseNameSnapshot,tc.clauseHtmlSnapshot,tc.clauseBehaviour,tc.conditionKey,tc.sortOrder,CASE WHEN tc.clauseBehaviour='mandatory' THEN 1 ELSE tc.defaultIncluded END,0,:userId,:userId2 FROM tbl_contract_template_clauses tc WHERE tc.tenantId=:tenantId AND tc.templateId=:templateId AND tc.isActive=1 ORDER BY tc.sortOrder,tc.id

UPDATE tbl_contract_document_clauses dc INNER JOIN tbl_generated_contracts gc ON gc.id=dc.contractId AND gc.tenantId=dc.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=gc.workflowId AND w.tenantId=gc.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=gc.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_locations l ON l.id=w.locationId AND l.tenantId=w.tenantId SET dc.clauseTextSnapshot=REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.clauseTextSnapshot,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'eventName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(w.workflowName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'eventDate',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(w.targetDate,'%d %M %Y'),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'venueName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(l.locationName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'artistName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE((SELECT fv.valueText FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.fieldKey='artist_name' LIMIT 1),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractFee',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE((SELECT fv.valueText FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.fieldKey='contract_fee' LIMIT 1),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'depositAmount',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE((SELECT fv.valueText FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.fieldKey='deposit_amount' LIMIT 1),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'balanceDueDate',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(fv.valueDate,'%d %M %Y'),fv.valueText) FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.fieldKey='balance_due_date' LIMIT 1),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'tenantName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(t.tenantName,'')) WHERE dc.contractId=:contractId AND dc.tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_contracting_entities ce ON ce.id=gc.contractingEntityId AND ce.tenantId=gc.tenantId SET gc.renderedHtml=REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(gc.renderedHtml,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.legalName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.legalName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.tradingName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.tradingName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.registrationNumber',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.registrationNumber,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.vatNumber',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.vatNumber,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.registeredAddress',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(', ',ce.addressLine1,ce.addressLine2,ce.townCity,ce.countyRegion,ce.postcode,ce.country),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.signatoryName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.signatoryName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.signatoryTitle',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.signatoryTitle,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.paymentTerms',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.defaultPaymentTerms,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.footer',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.contractFooter,'')) WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId

UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc LEFT JOIN tbl_workflow_commercial_details cd ON cd.workflowId=gc.workflowId AND cd.tenantId=gc.tenantId SET gc.renderedHtml=REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(gc.renderedHtml,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.availableFrom',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(cd.onSaleDateTime,'%d %M %Y at %H:%i'),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.currencyCode',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(cd.currencyCode,'GBP')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.capacity',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(cd.capacity,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.salesTarget',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),CASE WHEN cd.salesTarget IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(cd.currencyCode,'GBP'),' ',FORMAT(cd.salesTarget,2)) END),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.taxNotes',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(cd.taxNotes,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.notes',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(cd.notes,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'commercial.priceList',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE((SELECT CONCAT('
    ',GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('
  • ',pe.priceLabel,': ',CASE WHEN pe.calculationType='percentage_discount' THEN CONCAT(FORMAT(pe.amount,2),'%') WHEN pe.amount IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(cd.currencyCode,'GBP'),' ',FORMAT(pe.amount,2)) ELSE REPLACE(pe.calculationType,'_',' ') END,CASE WHEN pe.eligibility IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (',pe.eligibility,')') ELSE '' END,'
    • ') ORDER BY pe.displayOrder,pe.id SEPARATOR ''),'
') FROM tbl_workflow_price_entries pe WHERE pe.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND pe.workflowId=gc.workflowId AND pe.isActive=1),'')) WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,'contract',:contractId,'contract.generated',CONCAT(:actor,' generated contract ',:contractName),JSON_OBJECT('templateId',:templateId,'templateVersion',:versionNumber),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_activity_types at WHERE at.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND at.activityKey='contract.generated' AND at.isActive=1 LIMIT 1
